nodes.label: Thin-Pointer Design (Single Source of Truth)
nodes.rationale: Duplicating specs across agent frameworks (Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI) causes configuration drift the moment either copy changes. All runtimes therefore load canonical profile and workflow specs from CLAUDE.md and .claude/, and must not duplicate the rules.

nodes.label: Portable Portal Search Skills Pointer
nodes.rationale: Portal CLIs live under .agents/skills/ in the portable Agent Skills format (SKILL.md per portal) so Codex and Antigravity auto-discover them, while /scrape in .claude/skills/job-scraper/ orchestrates them.

nodes.label: framework_version Frontmatter Marker
nodes.rationale: Version markers on methodology files let a personalized fork see precisely which framework files a release touched, instead of diffing everything.
